'''2013 Alderaan Regionals Bren Derlin DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Bren Derlin]] at [[2013 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Invasion / In Complete Control]]
* '''Username:''' Bren Derlin
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
